claims.evidence: Witness only confirmed Xbox brand logo; no model-specific text or storage label visible to distinguish One from Series S/X or One X/S variant
Photo 0, 1, and 2 all show two wireless controllers (white and blue) with console
Origin/import history cannot be determined from photos; no UK plug adapter or regional packaging shown
Only top and side angles shown; no close-up of vents, ports, or casing for scratches, dents, or yellowing
Digital game/software entitlement cannot be confirmed from exterior photos; no disc, code, or screen showing library
Vague claim with no corresponding item visible in any photo

risks.risk: Console model (One vs One S/X vs Series) affects base value significantly
risks.proof: Clear photo/video of rear label or settings menu showing model/storage size
risks.if_unproven: priced as base Xbox One (lowest common variant)

risks.risk: No power cable or HDMI cable shown; may be missing
risks.proof: Photo of full accessory bundle including cables
risks.if_unproven: priced as console+controllers only, no cables

risks.risk: Console not tested powering on; internal fault risk (disc drive, HDMI port, overheating)
risks.proof: Video of console powering on to dashboard with a game loading

risks.risk: Controller battery compartments and battery condition unknown
risks.proof: Photo of open battery covers showing batteries/rechargeable packs

risks.risk: Cosmetic damage (scratches, cracks, discoloration) not visible from angles shown
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all sides including vents and underside
risks.if_unproven: priced as average cosmetic condition, not 'like new'

risks.risk: FC26 claim may refer to a digital license tied to seller's account, not transferable
risks.proof: Screenshot of game ownership on console's account settings
risks.if_unproven: priced as console-only, game not included

risks.proof: Photo of system settings showing storage size
risks.if_unproven: priced at lowest typical capacity for that model line

risks.risk: Factory reset / account status unknown, could have seller's locked account
risks.proof: Video showing fresh setup screen or factory reset confirmation
risks.if_unproven: priced with risk of needing account recovery, lower end

proof_requests: Video of console powering on to home dashboard
Photo of rear panel showing model number and storage capacity label
Photos of all cables/accessories included in the sale
Close-up photos of console body (all sides) for scratches/damage
Screenshot or video showing FC26 game present in library on this console
response.reason: Witness confirmed it is an Xbox console with two controllers, enabling a worst-case price; model, condition, cables, and software claims remain unverified and should be priced conservatively until proof is provided.
